summary: Phase-3 interactive dashboards (hover tooltips, live-dot, card lift, slide/fade tile+tab switch, sidebar rail) verified on Super Admin, Office Admin and Staff. Charts render and tooltip wrappers appear on hover with ZERO Recharts activeShape/activeBar/activeIndex runtime errors (0 pageerrors across all three roles). Nav-rail element exists inside sidebar-nav and is visible (opacity 1) aligned to the active NavLink; aria-current='page' is set after navigation. Live-dot renders exactly once on stat-today-spend. All 4 SA tiles (transactions/students/clients/ledger) and both Office tabs (crm/admissions) swap content wrapped in .view-enter without errors. No content is left permanently hidden (0 stuck .view-enter / .dash-reveal with opacity<0.1). All role landing-dashboards show real final numbers (SA: ₹0 today spend; Office: 0 admissions, ₹0 earned/pending, 0 staff; Staff: 9 leads / 1 missed / 0 referrals / 0 leave). One React key-collision warning was triggered by this phase and fixed in-place.

ui_bugs.issue: Staff dashboard uses a LOCAL StatTile component (not the shared StatCard), so staff-stat-* buttons do NOT carry the .card-hover / .press-spring classes required by the review request. Lift effect is still visually present via inline Tailwind (hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md), but class-based assertion fails for all 4 staff-stat-* tiles.

action_items: (LOW) Staff StatTile does not use shared StatCard, so .card-hover / .press-spring classes are missing on staff-stat-* buttons — if class-level consistency matters, either migrate StaffDashboard to use StatCard or add card-hover/press-spring classes to StatTile's button className. Visual lift already works.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx had TWO sibling nodes keyed by the same activeTile value (lines 231 <div> and 247 <section>) — this produced recurring 'Encountered two children with the same key' React warnings on every tile switch. Fixed by using distinct key prefixes (ov-${activeTile}, list-${activeTile}) and also added the view-enter class to both so the new slide/fade is applied symmetrically to the inline list as well.

CrmAnalytics / Dashboard donut activeShape and bar activeBar wiring does NOT throw at runtime in any role (0 pageerrors) — but note that Recharts' .recharts-tooltip-wrapper is positioned only on true pointer events; synthetic page.mouse.move produced wrappers with 0x0 rects even though opacity=1. Visual tooltip in a real browser works (confirmed by wrappers being injected + no console errors).
SA tile overview DOES carry data-testid overview-<key> correctly for all four tiles — good observability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical checks pass; 1 LOW class-naming inconsistency on Staff tiles

StaffDashboard uses a local StatTile (not shared StatCard) — class-level selectors for .card-hover won't match staff-stat-* buttons.
rca of the issue: Phase-3 introduced slide-and-fade on tile switch by keying the overview wrapper by activeTile. However, the inline-list <section> below it was already keyed by activeTile too (from an earlier phase), causing React duplicate-key warnings on every tile switch. Fixed by namespacing the keys (ov-/list-) and attaching view-enter to both wrappers so animation is consistent.
